description: Ask to join an activity for your person, only after they said they want to. It asks to join the activity, all its dates, not one evening. Give your person the undoUrl: it is their own page for this request, and Withdraw is there. Keep it for them; the status URL alone can't take the request back.

activityId.description: The activity id, from /ask or spaces_get.

name.description: Optional first name or nickname; no email, phone or link.

spaceId.description: The group id, from /ask or spaces_list_public.
